summary: [Golden 001] Password reset and account unlock completed - case 1
request: The user could not sign in after repeated password attempts and the directory account became locked.
business_justification: Restore access to approved corporate services without changing the user's existing authorization.
checks: Verified the requester through the approved identity challenge.
Confirmed the account was active and not under an HR or security hold.
Checked sign-in logs for indicators of credential abuse.
resolution_steps: Unlocked the directory account.
Issued a temporary password through the approved secure channel.
Required password change at the next sign-in and revoked active sessions.
validation: User signed in with the temporary credential.
User changed the password and completed MFA.
No further failed sign-ins appeared during the observation window.
resolution_code: Solved - identity verified and access restored

request: A manager requested a standard corporate account for an approved new starter.
business_justification: Provide day-one access aligned to the employee's role and start date.
checks: Matched the request to an approved onboarding record.
Confirmed manager, department, start date, and license availability.
Verified that no active or dormant duplicate identity existed.
resolution_steps: Created the directory identity using the naming standard.
Assigned the baseline license and role-based groups.
Sent activation instructions to the manager through the approved channel.
validation: Account appeared in the directory and target applications.
Manager confirmed the expected baseline access.
User completed first sign-in and MFA registration.

request: The user required an additional application role to perform an assigned business function.
business_justification: Enable an approved duty while maintaining least privilege and segregation of duties.
checks: Confirmed manager and application-owner approval.
Checked role conflicts and segregation-of-duties rules.
Verified the requested access scope and expiry date.
resolution_steps: Assigned the least-privilege application role.
Recorded the approval reference in the access register.
Forced a fresh application session so the entitlement was re-evaluated.
validation: User demonstrated the required function.
A prohibited administrative function remained unavailable.
Entitlement appeared in the access review report.

summary: [Golden 004] Approved software installed on managed endpoint - case 1
request: The user requested an approved software package that was not present on the managed workstation.
business_justification: Provide the supported tool required for the user's assigned work.
checks: Confirmed the device was corporate-managed and compliant.
Verified software approval, license availability, and platform compatibility.
Checked that no conflicting or unsupported version was installed.
resolution_steps: Deployed the signed package through endpoint management.
Applied the standard configuration and security policy.
Recorded the installed version and license allocation.
validation: Application launched successfully under the user's account.
Endpoint protection reported no finding.
User completed the documented functional smoke test.

summary: [Golden 005] Active Directory group membership granted - case 1
request: The user needed membership in a controlled directory group for an approved resource.
business_justification: Grant narrowly scoped access required by the user's current role.
checks: Validated group owner and line-manager approval.
Reviewed nested-group impact and privileged-access classification.
Confirmed no conflicting entitlement was present.
resolution_steps: Added the user to the approved group.
Recorded the access owner and review date.
Triggered directory synchronization and refreshed the user session.
validation: Effective membership was visible on the target resource.
User accessed the approved resource only.
Access-review evidence contained the new membership.

summary: [Golden 006] Approved project release promoted to production - case 1
request: A tested project release required controlled promotion from staging to production.
business_justification: Deliver an approved production change while preserving rollback and auditability.
checks: Verified change approval, maintenance window, test evidence, and business owner sign-off.
Confirmed backups, deployment artifact checksum, dependencies, and rollback plan.
Checked monitoring health and absence of conflicting production changes.
resolution_steps: Placed the service in the approved change window.
Promoted the immutable release artifact using the deployment runbook.
Applied configuration, ran migrations, and retained the previous release for rollback.
validation: Smoke tests and health checks passed.
Business owner validated the critical user journey.
Monitoring remained normal and the change record was closed.

request: The user required remote access to approved internal services from a managed device.
business_justification: Support authorized remote work without exposing unrestricted network access.
checks: Confirmed employment status, manager approval, and device compliance.
Verified MFA enrollment and the required network access profile.
Checked for an existing suspended or duplicate VPN entitlement.
resolution_steps: Assigned the restricted VPN profile.
Installed the managed client configuration.
Registered the entitlement for periodic access review.
validation: User connected with MFA from the managed endpoint.
Only approved network routes were reachable.
Authentication and tunnel logs showed a successful compliant session.

summary: [Golden 008] MFA method replaced after device change - case 1
request: The user replaced or lost the registered authentication device and could not complete MFA.
business_justification: Restore secure authentication after verifying the account holder.
checks: Completed enhanced identity verification.
Reviewed recent sign-ins and confirmed the old device was no longer trusted.
Checked that the request was not associated with an active security incident.
resolution_steps: Revoked the old MFA registration and active sessions.
Issued a time-limited registration method.
Registered the replacement authenticator and required a new sign-in.
validation: User completed MFA with the replacement device.
The old method no longer authenticated.
The identity audit log recorded revocation and registration.

request: An analyst required read-only access to an approved reporting database and schema.
business_justification: Enable reporting while preventing data modification and unnecessary data exposure.
checks: Confirmed data-owner and manager approval.
Reviewed data classification and mandatory training.
Validated that the requested schema and duration matched the business need.
resolution_steps: Created or mapped the user to the read-only database role.
Restricted connectivity to the approved network path.
Recorded the grant, owner, scope, and expiry in the access register.
validation: A permitted SELECT query succeeded.
INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE, and administrative operations were denied.
Audit logging captured the test session.
resolution_code: Fulfilled - scoped read-only data access granted

request: The user required access to a team mailbox for an approved operational responsibility.
business_justification: Allow the team to manage shared correspondence with accountable permissions.
checks: Confirmed mailbox owner and manager approval.
Validated whether read/manage or send-as permission was required.
Checked for conflicting delegation and retention restrictions.
resolution_steps: Granted only the approved mailbox permissions.
Applied the standard automapping setting.
Recorded the delegate and review date.
validation: Mailbox appeared in the user's client after token refresh.
The user could perform approved actions only.
Mailbox audit logging recorded the validation action.

request: The user needed membership in a controlled business distribution list.
business_justification: Ensure the user receives role-relevant operational communications.
checks: Confirmed list owner approval and membership criteria.
Verified that the address was active and not already nested in the list.
Checked restrictions for confidential or regulated communications.
resolution_steps: Added the user as a direct member of the approved list.
Triggered directory synchronization.
Documented ownership and the next review date.
validation: Membership was visible in the directory.
A controlled test message was delivered.
No unintended distribution lists were added.

request: The managed laptop had a confirmed hardware fault that prevented reliable work.
business_justification: Restore productivity while preserving corporate data and asset accountability.
checks: Confirmed the hardware diagnosis and warranty status.
Verified backup or approved data-recovery status.
Matched an available replacement to the user's role profile.
resolution_steps: Prepared the replacement with the standard managed image.
Restored approved user data and required applications.
Transferred asset ownership and quarantined the faulty device for repair or secure disposal.
validation: Device compliance, encryption, endpoint protection, and patching were healthy.
User completed sign-in and application smoke tests.
Asset inventory reflected both the replacement and returned device.

request: The user required a licensed SaaS product for an approved role responsibility.
business_justification: Provide required functionality while controlling recurring license cost.
checks: Confirmed manager approval and product eligibility.
Checked available license inventory and duplicate subscriptions.
Verified that a lower-cost role would not satisfy the requirement.
resolution_steps: Allocated the minimum suitable license tier.
Assigned the standard security and sharing policy.
Recorded the cost center and license-review date.
validation: User accessed the licensed features.
The license console showed one active assignment.
No duplicate license remained allocated.

summary: [Golden 014] Service account provisioned with controlled credentials - case 1
request: An approved workload required a non-interactive identity for a defined integration.
business_justification: Enable automation with traceable ownership and minimum privileges.
checks: Confirmed application-owner and security approval.
Documented purpose, owner, environments, required permissions, and expiry.
Verified that a managed identity was unavailable or unsuitable.
resolution_steps: Created the non-interactive account using the service naming standard.
Assigned only the approved roles and denied interactive sign-in where supported.
Stored the generated credential in the approved secrets manager with rotation metadata.
validation: The workload authenticated and completed its permitted operation.
Interactive and unrelated resource access were denied.
Monitoring, rotation, and ownership records were present.

request: An engineer required access to a source repository for an assigned project.
business_justification: Enable contribution while protecting branches and sensitive repositories.
checks: Confirmed repository owner and manager approval.
Verified employment status, security training, and team membership.
Selected the minimum read or write role required.
resolution_steps: Added the user through the approved repository team.
Applied branch protection and required-review policies.
Recorded the access grant for periodic review.
validation: User cloned the repository and created a test branch where authorized.
Protected-branch direct push remained blocked.
Repository audit logs recorded the access change.

summary: [Golden 016] Restricted SFTP exchange access configured - case 1
request: An approved partner exchange required access to a dedicated SFTP location.
business_justification: Transfer agreed files through a controlled, auditable channel.
checks: Confirmed data-owner, security, and partner approval.
Validated data classification, source IPs, retention, and exchange path.
Verified a unique account and SSH public key were supplied.
resolution_steps: Created a chrooted account restricted to the approved directory.
Installed the partner public key and source-IP restriction.
Enabled transfer logging, retention, and expiration controls.
validation: A test upload and download succeeded in the approved path.
Parent and peer directories were inaccessible.
Transfer and authentication events appeared in monitoring.

request: An application required a specific source-to-destination network flow that was blocked.
business_justification: Enable an approved service dependency without creating broad network exposure.
checks: Confirmed application owner and security approval.
Validated source, destination, protocol, port, environment, and expiry.
Reviewed overlap, threat exposure, and an available rollback plan.
resolution_steps: Created the narrow firewall rule in the approved change window.
Attached logging and the documented expiration date.
Committed the policy and monitored deployment health.
validation: The intended TCP connection succeeded.
Unapproved ports and sources remained blocked.
Firewall logs showed only the expected test traffic.

request: HR submitted an approved termination or departure event for a user account.
business_justification: Remove access on time while preserving required business records and legal holds.
checks: Validated the HR event, effective time, manager, and legal-hold requirements.
Collected the user's accounts, privileged roles, devices, sessions, and owned resources.
Confirmed mailbox and file-transfer instructions with the manager.
resolution_steps: Disabled sign-in and revoked active sessions and MFA methods.
Removed groups, licenses, tokens, VPN, and application access.
Transferred approved data ownership and updated the asset-return record.
validation: Authentication attempts were denied after the effective time.
Access reports showed no active entitlements.
Manager and HR confirmed data transfer and asset status.
resolution_code: Completed - access revoked and records retained

request: An engineer required console access to an approved cloud account and environment.
business_justification: Support operational duties with time-bound, least-privilege cloud authorization.
checks: Confirmed manager, account owner, and security approval.

resolution_steps: Assigned the approved federated role to the engineer's access group.
Applied session duration and environment restrictions.
Recorded owner, purpose, and access-review date.
validation: Federated sign-in with MFA succeeded.

Administrative actions outside the role remained denied and logged.
